note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 against HEAD c8584247bb (independent judge, clean clone). Upgraded from weak. Section 2.9: "When the responder chooses a subset of the traffic proposed by the initiator, it narrows the Traffic Selectors to some subset of the initiator's proposal (provided the set does not become the null set)." The defect the weak verdict recorded is fixed at the producer by a8797fd0c2: substituteVirtualIP keeps a proposed TSi only when leaseHostIn finds the lease host inside it (containsNet, family read from the mask length) and narrows it to that host with its port and protocol kept, drops every other selector, and answers TS_UNACCEPTABLE when none is left, before narrowSelectors, floorWithinProposal and the floor check run, so the policy match and the rekey floor judge only selectors the proposal covers. Every answered selector is therefore a subset of a proposed one on the pool-bound path as on the policy path. New tagged carrier TestRFC7296VirtualIPAnsweredOnlyInsideTheProposal drives narrowChildSelectors for a leased responder: 0.0.0.0/0 and the pool /29 are answered exactly lease/32 <-> 0.0.0.0/0, fresh and on a rekey over that scope; 192.0.2.50/32 and an IPv4-mapped IPv6 range draw errTSUnacceptable with no recorded pair, fresh and with floor lease/32 <-> 0.0.0.0/0 (the exact scenario of the earlier overlay probe). Its records (leaseHostIn containsNet -> true / -> false) were observed red; the other-host case is the containment discriminator, the mapped case refuses for lack of an IPv6 lease. TestCreateChildUsesLease and TestRemoteSelectorIsLease, which encoded the widening, now assert TS_UNACCEPTABLE for a proposal outside the lease. Policy-path carriers unchanged and still assert the subset rule (TestResponderNarrowsBothSelectorsToPolicy, TestTSUnacceptableIsSentWhenNothingIsAcceptable, TestRFC7296RekeyFloorIsAnsweredOnlyInsideTheProposal, TestRFC7296ResponderAnswersOnlyCombinationsItChose, TestChildRekeyInitiatorInstallsTheAnsweredSelectors). All PASS at HEAD (./le job run, scoped -run). ./le rfc discriminate id RFC7296-2.9-1: eight records, none stale; four carriers' claims remain unproven by record and were judged by reading.
